Captain Lain and EB III set out to catch sharks on the patch reefs, and are shocked when a giant sawfish breaks the surface instead. Lain visits Jessica Ann Art to pick up a gift. Chef Cat whips up a shrimp primavera that's easy to make at home.

title: Spear Life
description:
S06 E03 — The Annual Brunson Bash
The Spear Life Gang is hanging at home for this trip, but they're gonna be joined by one of Jon's good friends, retired NBA star Brad Miller, with plans of spearfishing, scallop hunting, and ending with a huge party at the house.

title: Gale Force Twins
description:
S01 E06 — West Palm kitefishing/Bahamas Pole Spear
Identical twins Amanda and Emily Gale head offshore in West Palm Florida for kite fishing and then make a run to the Bahamas for spearfishing with a legend.

title: Uncharted Waters With Peter Miller
description:
S04 E07 — The Big Fish Bonanza -- Uncharted Waters
Peter Miller travels the world sharing his biggest catches, from largemouth bass, tuna, swordfish, mahi-mahi, marlin and more.

title: Fly Fusion
description:
S01 E01 — Explore
Filmed in British Columbia's Kootenay region, co-hosts Jim McLennan and Derek Bird fly fish for oversized bull trout and Westslope cutthroat.
